indicator_definition: Proportion of terrestrial and freshwater areas designated as protected, as a percentage of total land area. Includes Natura 2000 and nationally designated areas. Data compiled by Eurostat and the EEA.
rationale: Protected areas are a cornerstone of biodiversity conservation. Progress means an increasing proportion of land and freshwater under effective protection.
methodology_characteristics: Data compiled from national designations reported to the EEA. Natura 2000 forms the backbone of the EU network. Covers both terrestrial and freshwater habitats. Published annually.
